OrkanSlicer Nightly 2.5 · 0.8.464

• UI 2.1 ColorFlow foundation: Compose uses layered navy surfaces and clear secondary text in dark mode; the light theme is preserved.
• App settings now use shared accessible accordions and value rows with reliable touch targets. Existing settings actions and save flows remain connected.
